findings.title: Do not bypass installer verification when the integration row is missing
findings.body: When no Integration row exists for the supplied installation ID, this branch advances directly to completion without comparing the authenticated GitHub user with the installer. Completion can fetch the installation using the app's credentials in build_integration(), so authenticating as any GitHub user is sufficient to claim such an installation. This also creates a bypass window before the installation webhook has created the row. Missing installer information must fail closed or be verified through another trusted source rather than skipping the new security check.

findings.title: Handle integrations that lack sender metadata
findings.body: The new verification unconditionally indexes integration.metadata["sender"]["login"], but build_integration() only adds sender when it is present in pipeline state; the updated basic-flow test explicitly creates an integration without this field. If an integration created through that path remains after its OrganizationIntegration is removed, attempting to install it again raises KeyError and returns a server error instead of the intended invalid-installation response. Handle absent sender information explicitly and fail closed.
